title: Skill Bundle Manifest
description: Contract for skill-bundle-manifest.json. PRD-0047 §7. This file is the published, external-consumable contract (e.g. decisive's census); lib/bundle/manifest-schema.js enforces the same contract fail-closed at publish and install. Legacy aliases (`skill` -> `bundle_name`, file `path` -> `source`/`target`) are BLESSED-AND-DEPRECATED: accepted for backward compatibility, but publish emits a deprecation warning. `distribution.mode` and `projection.mode` are DIFFERENT namespaces and must never be validated against each other.

allOf.description: Identity: bundle_name is required, but the deprecated `skill` alias satisfies it.
Type: bundle_type is required, but a manifest carrying the deprecated `skill` alias is a skill_bundle by implication (matches the installer).
The state kind and state_seed role are reserved for memory snapshots because non-memory hashing intentionally excludes state payloads.

bundle_name.description: Canonical bundle identity. Required unless the deprecated `skill` alias is present.

skill.description: DEPRECATED alias for `bundle_name`. Accepted for backward compatibility; publish warns.

bundle_version.description: Human-facing version (semver by convention). Content identity is `bundle_hash`, not this field. Publish refuses changed content (differing `bundle_hash`) under an unchanged `bundle_version`.

bundle_hash.description: Content identity over the bundle payload. This — not the version string — is identity.

metadata.description: Optional metadata. PRD-0047 §7 refers to a human version as `metadata.version`; in the live format the human version field is top-level `bundle_version`. If `metadata.version` is present it must be a non-empty string. Requiring `metadata.version` fleet-wide is a migration decision owned by decisive and is intentionally NOT enforced here.

dependencies.description: Runtime npm dependencies that bundle install resolves into the target repository. Values are npm version ranges; changing this object changes bundle content identity.

source.description: Upstream provenance: which repo and exact commit the bundle resolved from (PRD-0047 §4).

distribution.description: How the bundle is DELIVERED. Distinct namespace from `projection`.

projection.description: How the bundle is EMITTED into the target. Distinct namespace from `distribution`. `repo_materialization` is a projection mode and must never be accepted as a `distribution.mode`.

validation.description: `validation.commands` run ONLY for repo-authored manifests, never for hosted/remote installs (PRD-0047 §7 trust boundary).

key_path.description: Required for json_set (matches the installer's normalizeMutation). Forbidden segments (__proto__/constructor/prototype) are additionally rejected by the code validator.

files.description: Published entry-level contract. The runtime validator additionally enforces cross-entry initializer constraints (a unique, required, bundled non-runtime-state script target) that JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express against sibling entries.

path.description: DEPRECATED alias supplying both `source` and `target`. Accepted for backward compatibility; publish warns.

role.description: Semantic file role. Values mirror the installer's known taxonomy; root-level validation reserves state_seed for memory snapshots.

initializer.description: WO §2: a repo-relative script that creates this file if absent at install. Only valid with role: required_data. Null when absent (normalized output).

anyOf.description: Deprecated: the `path` alias supplies both source and target.

allOf.description: Initializers are only valid for required_data entries.
